north_star: Discover learned recurrent causal state formation that transfers persistent entity bindings, masked latent states and delayed intervention response beyond static graph probes.
hypothesis: TRAIN-derived, entity-permutation invariant learned local recurrent causal transition statistics, carried as a bounded proof-carrying predictive memory over a hidden graph and hidden evolving entity state, will reduce complete native cost or improve certified counterfactual coverage on genuinely new masked temporal worlds vs equally TRAIN-informed recurrent exact Bayesian and full-history controls.
novelty: 6 interacting binary entities; recurrent partially hidden state, latent graph and gate; seven masked chronological frames, delayed interventions and posthistory two-step counterfactuals. No T25 static full-pre-state observation reuse, no prior S3 symbolic ranking/motif.

source.origin: internally originated after freeze, not external replication
source.family_R: nonlinear mediated recurrent cycles under rotating masked sensors and delayed intervention
source.family_S: long-range nonlinear latent causal loops under independently permuted topology and perturbed sensor/intervention timing
source.public_history_actions: at source-authored transition steps 1 and 3; apply overwrite of a selected next-state entity
source.prospect_query: two future transitions with first-step intervention and 3 target node questions; all share the same latent persistent graph/state

mechanism.TRAIN: infer Boolean next-state transition table keyed by hidden mode, own state, two persistent-parent state bits using observed chronological triples and exact public source-consistent posterior; train from public masked frames only; NEVER use private hidden graph, initial state or counterfactual truth
mechanism.proof: verify every learned table entry against independently computed Boolean algebra; missing entries always fall back to exact known grammar
mechanism.recurrence: under each globally consistent latent graph and initial state, update the same persistent entity identities through every historical frame and intervention, filter by visible observations; preserve exact surviving posterior, no lossy pruning
mechanism.counterfactual: recurrent memory from all 7 frames is advanced two further transitions with public intervention; certify node output only when EVERY globally possible graph/state yields the same result; else abstain

preregistered_gates.TRAIN_preflight: prove exact hidden-world truth remains in temporal posterior for all 40 TRAIN; zero false positive on TRAIN, at least 20% target outcomes genuinely posterior-ambiguous, learn at least 8 distinct Boolean table entries, prove each entry with independent truth table; no DEV built
preregistered_gates.original_Prospective: 64 fresh source cases, 192 source-bound two-step questions, five separate whole-process CPU/RSS samples for all four arms on Windows+Linux; all false positives zero; no baseline certified coverage loss; strict improvement in certificate coverage against strongest TRAIN recurrent exact or same coverage and strict complete CPU gain with no RSS regression against all strongest trained controls
preregistered_gates.no_late_changes: if TRAIN gate fails, no first use; do not change frozen admission by using DEV or retuning same DEV
preregistered_gates.no_inference_equating: No claim of independently reproduced science; learned truth table being verified algebraically does NOT prove better learned cognition without unmatched prospective resource and capability gain
